description: This is a JUnit test class for the BookImportController in a Spring-based Java application. It tests that the import method correctly invokes the import service delegate with a file, specifically testing the importFromLibraryThing method using a mock multipart file loaded from resources.

classes.name: BookImportControllerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for BookImportController, testing import method invocation and ensuring correct delegate method calls.

methods.name: shouldInvokeProperImportHandler
methods.description: Tests that the importFromLibraryThing method of BookImportController calls importServiceDelegate.importFromLibraryThing exactly once and does not call importFromGoodreads.

methods.name: getTestFile
methods.description: Loads a sample JSON import file from resources as a MockMultipartFile for testing purposes.
